pagetitle: "URBE Lab"

::: kicker
Urban exposome · Healthy aging
:::

We develop new ways to measure urban nature at scale and link them, together with air pollution and the built and social environment, to large electronic health record and geospatial datasets to understand cardiometabolic risk, biological aging, and cognitive health across diverse urban populations.

We are based in the [Department of Environmental Medicine](https://icahn.mssm.edu/about/departments/environmental-medicine) at the Icahn School of Medicine at Mount Sinai in New York City.
